title: Export valid percussion notes currently rejected by GP8
scope: Close missing native articulation mappings for valid percussion values found by the broad audit.
acceptance: Reproduce the rejected values in canon.gp5, full-song.gp5, nightwish.gp5 and upstream percussion-all.gp5.
Compare the source articulation, intended output MIDI and supported GP8 definition before adding a mapping.
Valid mappings preserve identity, notation and playback across all relevant staves/graces; unsupported values retain a precise rejection.
exclusions: Do not blanket-map arbitrary MIDI values to a convenient drum.
Conflicting staff line-count limits need separate representability evidence.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce the rejected values in canon.gp5, full-song.gp5, nightwish.gp5 and upstream percussion-all.gp5.

evidence.detail: Public contract; linked matrix cases are in obligation.
Existing scoped evidence; not proof of all AlphaTab variants.
Covers all 39 newly supported native inputs through exact wire metadata, public reimport, main and grace notes, and scoped unsupported rejection.
Reproduces canon.gp5, full-song.gp5, nightwish.gp5, and upstream percussion-all.gp5.
The pinned consumer verifies every input, output MIDI exception, staff line, notehead, and technique marker.

resolution: GP8 export now creates exact native Guitar Pro percussion definitions for identity-free note and grace inputs 29-31, 33-34, 39-40, 54, 56, and 58-87. Each definition retains its authored input identity, native element and soundbank, staff line, duration-specific noteheads, technique marker, RSE sound, and output MIDI, including the seven nonidentity output mappings and AlphaTab's last-write Tinkle Bell selection for input 83. Custom track articulations remain authoritative, including an explicit exact grace input outside the native table; only a legacy zero sentinel with no ExactFret inherits the parent note identity. The three corpus fixtures now export, the upstream all-values fixture isolates only 27, 28, and 32, and unmatched or out-of-MIDI-range exact grace values retain location-specific rejection. Blanket MIDI aliases and staff-line-count redesign remain outside this ticket.
